description: This file defines the GuzzleStream class which adapts a PSR-7 Stream to a Guzzle 5 Stream interface. It serves as an adapter to bridge between PSR-7 streams and Guzzle 5 streams used in HTTP client operations.

classes.name: GuzzleStream
classes.description: An adapter class that implements GuzzleStreamInterface and wraps a PSR-7 Stream to enable compatibility between Guzzle 5 and PSR-7 streams.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GuzzleStream with a PSR-7 StreamInterface instance.
